title: Wahaj Framework: remote sensing and machine learning for urban greening-energy trade-offs in desalination-dependent cities (Jeddah case study)
description: Code, Google Earth Engine exports, result tables and figures of the Wahaj framework: a reproducible pipeline that combines Landsat 8 land surface temperature, a spatially validated XGBoost model, a matched-contrast benchmark of measured cooling where vegetation was established, counterfactual gates for model-based use, the Normalized Environmental Gain Index (NEGI) and a hypothetical water-energy ledger, applied to Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
